Pydantic upgraded from 1.10.26 to 2.14.0 (pinning `>=2,<3`) with accompanying migration of the internal codebase to `pydantic_settings` v2. Migration rules R1 (`__fields__` → `model_fields`) and R55 (`BaseSettings` → `pydantic_settings.BaseSettings`) were applied. Thirty-four of 43 baseline tests currently pass; the failing tests relate to settings source configuration and secret retrieval behavior.
